uninstall.description: This addon will be removed from your system, while its data is preserved. You can reinstall it from its source.

enable.title: Enable Dev Mode
enable.description:
Enabling dev mode will load this addon directly from source instead of pre-built bundles. Changes to the addon's codebase will hot-reload instantly without requiring a rebuild.

Use this when actively developing or customizing this addon.

disable.title: Disable Dev Mode
disable.description: Disabling dev mode will switch back to loading from pre-built bundles. Make sure you have rebuilt the addon to include your latest changes.
